steps.title: Plan the route
steps.body: Set the stops, and give your helpers a lead or sweep role for the night.

steps.title: A first hello at the first bar
steps.body: Guests check in and get one icebreaker to do with someone in the group, so people are mixing before the first move.

steps.title: Move between venues
steps.body: When the group leaves a stop, your lead confirms who left and where you’re heading next.

steps.title: Late arrivals find the group
steps.body: Someone arriving late is pointed to the stop you’ve confirmed you’re at, not the first one.

steps.title: The end-of-night sweep
steps.body: At the last stop, mark everyone accounted for. Anyone not marked stays on your list before you close the night.

items.question: Can I pay promoters on what they sell?
items.answer: Each promoter gets their own link, and {{brand.name}} shows the visits, bookings and revenue from it. How you pay them is up to you.

items.question: How do the groups work at a social night?
items.answer: {{brand.name}} puts guests into small groups from what they told you when they booked, and changes them a few times through the night. You set how many rounds and how long.

items.question: Who keeps the group together on a crawl?
items.answer: A lead and a sweep from your team, on their own phones. Your lead confirms who left each stop and where you’re heading next, and late arrivals are pointed to that stop.

items.question: What if someone leaves early?
items.answer: Mark them accounted for. Anyone not marked stays on your list before you close the night.

items.question: Do guests need an app?
items.answer: No. They book, check in and see their group in their phone’s browser.

items.question: Can the venues see the plan?
items.answer: Your lead and sweep see the stops on their own phones. Share the timings with your venues as you do today.
